newsitem.title: FRANCE: FRANCE'S DARMON 96/97 H1 TURNOVER SLIPS.
newsitem.headline: FRANCE'S DARMON 96/97 H1 TURNOVER SLIPS.

text.p: Groupe Jean-Claude Darmon reported its six-month figures to Dec 31, 1996:
(All figures in millions of French francs)

NOTE - Football advertising group Groupe Jean-Claude Darmon said in a statement that the fall in 1996/97 first-half turnover was due to a smaller number of sporting events in the period, and notably the earlier elimination of French football clubs from European cup championships.

Darmon said its first half coincided with the slacker part of the sporting season. It therefore still expected to be able to achieve its objective of full year turnover of 713 million francs, which the group forecast when it floated 15 percent of its capital on the Paris bourse second market in December.
